import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] A = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static int n, t;
    static boolean[][][][][] _dp = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] dp = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];

    static class State {
        int tt, x, y, x0, y0;
        State(int tt, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
            this.tt = tt;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.x0 = x0;
            this.y0 = y0;
        }
    }

    static void setdp_iter(int sx, int sy) {
        if (t >= 70) return;
        if (A[sx][sy] < '0' || A[sx][sy] > '9') return;
        Deque<State> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        st.push(new State(0, sx, sy, sx, sy));
        while (!st.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = st.pop();
            int tt = cur.tt, x = cur.x, y = cur.y, x0 = cur.x0, y0 = cur.y0;
            if (x < 0 || x >= n || y < 0 || y >= n) continue;
            if (A[x][y] < '0' || A[x][y] > '9') continue;
            if (tt > t + 1) continue;
            if (_dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0]) continue;
            if (tt > tim[x][y] && tim[x][y] != 0) continue;
            if (tt == tim[x][y] && tim[x][y] != 0 && (B[x][y] > '9' || B[x][y] <= '0')) continue;
            _dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0] = true;
            if (tt < tim[x][y]) {
                // push successors in reverse order to mimic recursion order
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x, y - 1, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x, y + 1, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x - 1, y, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x + 1, y, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x, y, x0, y0));
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                A[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                B[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // BFS using array queue
        int[][] q = new int[144][2];
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                tim[i][j] = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tim[i][j] = 0;
                    q[qt][0] = i;
                    q[qt][1] = j;
                    qt++;
                }
        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (qh < qt) {
            int[] p = q[qh++];
            if (tim[p[0]][p[1]] >= t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = p[0] + di[d];
                int nj = p[1] + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n &&
                    A[ni][nj] >= '0' && A[ni][nj] <= '9' && tim[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    tim[ni][nj] = tim[p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                    q[qt][0] = ni;
                    q[qt][1] = nj;
                    qt++;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (tim[i][j] == -1)
                    tim[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (A[i][j] >= '0' && A[i][j] <= '9')
                    setdp_iter(i, j);

        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G = new ArrayList<>();
        int[][] F = new int[210][210];
        int[] E = new int[210];
        int[] H = new int[210];
        int[][] C = new int[210][210];
        int[][] pN = new int[11][11];
        G.add(new ArrayList<>()); // node 0

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++)
                            dp[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= _dp[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                if (A[i1][j1] > '0' && A[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = G.size();
                    G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    E[k] = A[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                            if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9')
                                if (dp[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        _k = G.size();
                                        G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                        pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    G.get(k).add(_k);
                                    G.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                    G.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = B[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }

        // Push-relabel (same as variant 1)
        while (true) {
            boolean ff = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < G.size(); i++) {
                while (E[i] > 0) {
                    boolean f = true;
                    int minH = 10000;
                    for (int _j = 0; _j < G.get(i).size(); _j++) {
                        int j = G.get(i).get(_j);
                        if (C[i][j] - F[i][j] > 0) minH = Math.min(minH, H[j]);
                        if (C[i][j] - F[i][j] > 0 && H[i] == H[j] + 1) {
                            int d = Math.min(C[i][j] - F[i][j], E[i]);
                            F[i][j] += d;
                            F[j][i] -= d;
                            E[i] -= d;
                            E[j] += d;
                            f = false;
                            ff = false;
                            if (E[i] == 0) break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (E[i] == 0) break;
                    if (H[i] != minH + 1 && minH != 10000) {
                        f = false;
                        ff = false;
                        H[i] = minH + 1;
                    }
                    if (f) break;
                }
            }
            if (ff) break;
        }

        System.out.println(E[0]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
